PDF Volume Rendering of Time-Varying Scalar Fields on Unstructured Meshes
Abstract Volume Rendering of time-varying datasets is essential in several scientific applications. Due to the enormous amount of data involved, in datasets with static sampling regions it is common to consider only time-varying scalar fields (TVSFs).
